conditions.text: Japan (MAFF) requires a microchip, two rabies vaccinations, a rabies antibody titer test and 40-day advance notification; total preparation commonly reaches 180+ days. Required: microchip, rabies_vaccine, rabies_titer_test, advance_notification.

warnings.text: Air France does not carry dogs in the hold or cargo when forecast temperatures exceed 30 °C, for welfare reasons.

risks.text: Air France allows dogs in the cabin only up to 8 kg including the carrier.

alternatives.text: No placement works as requested. Try a lower cabin-weight airline, shift the date out of the heat window, or split the journey — the engine will list feasible options.
